hook.text: She couldn't follow the textbook description of photosynthesis until she drew it as a flowchart.

buildup.text: Flowcharts use boxes, arrows, and decision diamonds to map sequential processes and branching logic.

discovery.text: They are ideal for step-by-step processes, decision trees, and any content where order and branching matter.

twist.text: Drawing a flowchart from a text description forces you to identify the exact sequence.

climax.text: For any process-based content, convert the text into a flowchart. The translation from words to diagram is the learning.

punchline.text: Processes belong in flowcharts, not paragraphs.

quiz.question: Why does converting text to a flowchart improve learning?
options: Flowcharts use less paper than written notes
Identifying the exact sequence forces deep processing of the material
Flowcharts are easier to share with classmates
